rule detect_fqdn : detect_fqdn
{
    meta:
        author = "ACE Automation"
        description = "ACE Observable Export"
        tlp = "amber"
        date = "11/15/2026"
        scope = "['detection']"
        platform = "ACE"
    strings:
          $obsd_1 = /(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-])corp\.example([^a-zA-Z0-9_\-.]|\.[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-]|(\.)?$)/ ascii nocase
          $obsd_wide_1 = /(^|([^a-zA-Z0-9_\-]\x00|[\x00-\xff][^\x00]))c\x00o\x00r\x00p\x00\.\x00e\x00x\x00a\x00m\x00p\x00l\x00e\x00(([^a-zA-Z0-9_\-.]\x00|[\x00-\xff][^\x00])|\.\x00([^a-zA-Z0-9_\-]\x00|[\x00-\xff][^\x00])|(\.\x00)?$)/ nocase

    condition:
        any of ($obsd_*)
}
